title: Tangent bound for a biased power expression
statement:
Let $p,t,z\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $1<p<2$, $0<t<1$, and $0\le z\le1$. Then
\[
\bigl((1+t)^p+(1-t)^p\bigr)^{2/p}+\bigl((1+t)^p+(1-t)^p\bigr)^{2/p-1}\frac{(1+t)^{p-1}-(1-t)^{p-1}}{t}(z-t^2)\le\bigl((1+\sqrt z)^p+(1-\sqrt z)^p\bigr)^{2/p}.
\]
